description:
[Merchant] Delete one airing rule.

**Endpoint:** DELETE /products/{productId}/placements/{placementId}/airings/{ruleId} (PRM plan)

placementId.description: The placement's ID: pl + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pl7e4rCToG

productId.description: The product's ID: pr + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pr7e4rCToG

ruleId.description: The airing rule's ID, from payware_products_list_airings

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_delete_airing
